title: GPU rendering
summary: Breenix renders on the GPU through a validated, per-process command stream that a hardware GPU executes on every target, and reads every result back from the device pixel-exact under the deterministic rendering profile, with modes up to 2560x1600 presented within the stated bounds.

cases.title: Syscall 416's VERSION op returns 1
The device's 3D feature is negotiated: VirGL, SVGA3D DX contexts, or native GK208B classes
CAPS returns the profile record from the device's capability set or native classes, each capability id once
B8G8R8A8 and R8G8B8A8 render and sample, and R8 samples, by the device's own capability entries
The device reports integer shader operations, integer texel fetch and region copies
CAPS reports a maximum target size of at least 2560x1600 and at most 16384
The CAPS record has its documented version and size, with backend-specific origin and reserved fields valid
A masked profile capability fails initialization naming it
With a capability masked every op refuses with that reason and nothing renders another way
cases.expect: A solid green (#00FF00) 16x16 square; the refused red draw leaves it green, with no text.

cases.title: The device reports its scanouts and their sizes
CAPS names backend 4 (VirGL), 5 (SVGA3D DX), or 6 (GK208B), with its required features and classes
A forced device error reaches the submitting context as EIO naming the device's answer
CONTEXT_CREATE returns an owned context within 10 s that draws while its fixed rendering catalogue warms, reports the warm-up complete, and its first PROBE warms probe_int
cases.expect: A green (#00FF00) 4x4 square with one blue-grey (#345678) pixel at (1,1); no text.
